title: Royalties and Reality: Making Cents of Unreal | Unreal Fest 2024
description: With Unreal Engine 5.4, Epic Games is introducing a new licensing model. Join Unreal Engine Evangelist Ari Arnbjörnsson as he explains Unreal's royalties and licensing, our new seat-based subscription for non-game industries, and how they fit in the greater Epic Games ecosystem of software and services.
